timeline.evidenceText: Manasseh had three heights in Issachar, in Asher Beth Shean and its towns, and Ibleam and its towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and its towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and its towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns.
Out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach with its pasture lands, and Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: two cities.

Manasseh didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth Shean which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beth Shean to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

definitions.short: Taanak or Tanak , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H8590. Tanak תַּעְנָךְ proper name, of a location in Great Plain , [ ׳ת Baer Gi; van d. H. תַּעֲנָח , except Josh 21:25 ; 1Chr 7:29 ]; usually named with Megiddo: old Can. City, Judg 5:19 ; Josh 12:21 ( = Egyptian Ta-'-n-k-â, Ta-'a-na-k , WMM As.u.Eur.170, 195 ); assigned to Manasseh 17:11 ; 21:25 ; Jeremiah 1:27; 1Chr 7:29 (yet within territory of Issachar Josh 17:11 ; 19:18 ff.); named also 1Kin 4:12 ; ᵐ5 Θανααχ , Θααναχ , Ταναχ , etc.; = modern Ta'annuk , approximately 4 2-Janmiles south-southeast from Lejjun (Megiddo), Rob BR iii. 117 Guevrin Sam. ii. 226 ff. Buhl G 288 f. Wilson Hast. DB TAANACH .
